articles.title: Del Piero praises Como’s Champions League debut: ‘The only Italian team to win’
articles.summary: Alessandro Del Piero was full of praise for the players, staff and ownership group at Como after their statement win in their first ever Champions League mat...
articles.body:
Alessandro Del Piero was full of praise for the players, staff and ownership group at Como after their statement win in their first ever Champions League match on Thursday evening, and was keen to point out that Cesc Fabregas 's side were the only one of the Italian sides to get their continental campaign off to a winning start.

Como were taking part in their first ever match in the Champions League on Thursday night after an historic fourth-place finish in Serie A last term, and went on to impress neutrals across Europe with an encouraging 4-1 victory over knock-out round regulars RB Leipzig .

COMO, ITALY – SEPTEMBER 10: Nico Paz celebrates with teammates after the UEFA Champions League 2026/27 League Phase MD1 match between Como 1907 and RB Leipzig at Giuseppe Sinigaglia Stadium on September 10, 2026 in Como, Italy. (Photo by Claudio Villa/Getty Images)

Martin Baturina , Tasos Douvikas , Assane Diao and Maxi Perrone provided the goals on a special night at the Stadio Sinigaglia.

"Everything was special, the result, the first day for Como in Europe, making history, the vibe, the enthusiasm of the people, a lot of things happened tonight in a good way for Como and we are super happy," said an impressed Del Piero in his post-match debrief with CBS Sports .

"I am actually super happy because representing Italy, they were the only win from four teams, so let's cheer for Como."

MADRID, SPAIN – MAY 08: Alessandro Del Piero looks on prior to the UEFA Champions League semi-final second leg match between Real Madrid and FC Bayern München at Estadio Santiago Bernabeu on May 08, 2024 in Madrid, Spain. (Photo by Clive Brunskill/Getty Images)

Del Piero was asked what impresses him most about Como and their trajectory under Fabregas.

He replied: "There's different things. They're super well organised, they show that organisation all the time. They have great energy for 60 minutes, I don't want to say they dominate the game, but basically yes, they control the game, a lot of great personality.

"The question everyone is asking now even in Italy is how are they going to do it for the whole year playing Sunday-Wednesday-Sunday-Wednesday. But they are super happy, from Fabregas to the players, the ownership has a great chemistry with the staff and the players and everything looks just perfect. They don't show any weak points at the moment."

articles.title: Breaking Down Mark Sanchez’s Legal Issues
articles.summary: The former football player and Fox Sports analyst is dealing with charges stemming from a 2025 incident.
articles.body:
In 2025, Mark Sanchez was fired from Fox Sports after an arrest put him in the spotlight for all the wrong reasons. The professional athlete, who played pro football from 2009 to 2018, worked as an analyst at ESPN from 2019 to 2021, then Fox Sports from 2021 to 2025.

His legal case is back in the news this week after he revealed his plans to enter a guilty plea and avoid a trial. Below, we rounded up everything to know about Sanchez's legal issues and what's next.

Just after midnight on October 4, 2025, Sanchez was involved in an altercation with a 69-year-old truck driver named Perry Tole in Indianapolis. The former athlete was left in critical condition with "several stab wounds to his upper right torso area," per an affidavit obtained by People . Tole, meanwhile, had a "laceration to his left cheek," and told officials he stabbed Sanchez in self defense (Sanchez claimed he did not remember what happened.)

Detective Joshua Stayton viewed security footage from the scene and wrote in the affidavit that Tole's account "closely matches the video."

Tole said he had just pulled into a loading dock when Sanchez approached his truck. Sanchez allegedly told the truck driver that he was not needed that night (Tole's job is to collect cooking oil from restaurants), and then tried to enter the truck himself. He also allegedly blocked Tole from re-entering the truck twice, even "shoving" him against a wall at one point, per the affidavit.

"Tole realized things had escalated, and he was now in physical danger, so he reached into his pocket and grabbed his pepper spray and sprayed Mr. Sanchez in the face," Detective Stayton wrote. When Sanchez advanced on him from there, Tole feared the former analyst was "trying to kill" him, which led him to pull out a knife and stab Sanchez three times in self defense.

Initially, Sanchez was charged with misdemeanor counts of battery, unlawful entry to a motor vehicle, and public intoxication. A few days later, he also received a felony count of battery resulting in serious bodily injury, in addition to the three misdemeanor charges.

"This was a situation that did not need to occur," Chief Trial Deputy Ryan Mears of the Marion County Prosecutor's Office said. "The allegations involve a 38-year-old man becoming involved in an altercation with a 69-year-old man who sustained significant and very severe injuries as a result of that altercation."

Just over a month after the incident, Sanchez was fired from Fox Sports. "We can confirm that Mark Sanchez is no longer with the network," a statement said. "There will be no further comment at this time."

How many years in prison is Mark Sanchez facing?

The felony battery charge could result in up to six years in prison for Sanchez. However, ahead of his trial, which was scheduled for September 8, Sanchez agreed to enter a guilty plea.

His legal team asked the court to schedule a guilty plea and sentencing hearing, although it was not specified which charges he planned to plead guilty to. The specifics of the plea deal also have not been made public yet.

"This is a positive development," Sanchez's legal advisor said in a statement. "We are finalizing an agreement with the prosecutor's office that provides a path toward resolving the state's case. We're also encouraged by the constructive conversations taking place regarding the related civil matter. There is real momentum toward bringing this entire chapter to a close."

Tole's lawyer added, "We are pleased with the constructive and professional conversations we've had with Mr. Sanchez's team. Our discussions have been productive, and we're on a positive path toward an agreement that will allow the parties to move forward. Mr. Tole appreciates the progress we have achieved and looks forward to an amicable resolution."

articles.title: Arch Manning has learned to accept the reality of fame at Texas
articles.summary: The most recognizable face in college football doesn't like the spotlight.
articles.body:
Arch Manning grew up with something few college athletes ever experience. The pressure to live up to the expectations of his family name.

As the grandson of Archie Manning and nephew of Peyton and Eli Manning, Arch entered his time with the Texas Longhorns carrying a torch much heavier than anyone imagined. How does Manning handle the fame that comes will being football royalty? It's not easy for the young quarterback, but he has learned to live with that attention while trying to remain a normal college student.

What makes Arch's situation unusual is that he never appeared to seek fame. His father, Cooper Manning, remembers Arch saying as a young child that he wanted to play quarterback in college but had no interest in becoming famous. Yet his talent and family background made attention unavoidable from the public eye. It's something Marshall Manning, Peyton's son, will have to deal with very soon.

"Arch always said growing up, I can remember him being 6 or 7, 'I want to play quarterback one day in college, but I don't have any interest in being famous,'" Arch's father, Cooper Manning told ESPN .

His grandfather, Archie, agrees, saying Arch wants to be normal. "He doesn't like it," he said. "He'll handle it. He doesn't seek it. He likes low-key ... He's not a limelight guy. He really does like the locker room, likes his teammates."

But can a Manning really be "normal" in the football world? By the time Arch arrived at Texas, he was already one of the most recognizable players in college football. He was also a top NIL earner as well. Manning has gradually learned to accept both realities.

Despite the pressure, Arch stays humble and ordinary. He focuses heavily on the preparation with his teammates and does not appear interested in being flashy. Ultimately, Manning's story is not simply about football talent or a legendary family.

Even though that is what got him to this point. Manning's greatest challenge may be proving that he's different despite his last name. He is determined to create an identity of his own in a pre-existing world that is determined he has to be great at football.

The biggest test of Manning's career comes on Saturday as No. 4 Texas hosts No. 1 Ohio State (7:30 p.m. ET, ABC). This is the point in Arch's career where he can take a step forward and avenge the 14-7 loss to the Buckeyes last season.

articles.title: Michael Carrick provides Luke Shaw update ahead of derby after missing Champions League opener
articles.summary: Luke Shaw was absent from Manchester United's UEFA Champions League opener against Sabah, with Michael Carrick providing an update on the defender's fitness...
articles.body:
Michael Carrick has confirmed that Luke Shaw 's absence against Sabah on Thursday was purely precautionary. The fullback was left out of the Red Devils' squad during their commanding 4-0 victory in their UEFA Champions League opener at Old Trafford.

The United manager has reassured supporters that Shaw was not sidelined by any serious concern, with the decision made to protect the defender ahead of this weekend's highly anticipated derby showdown with crosstown rivals Manchester City .

Speaking ahead of Thursday's match, Carrick said, via The Mirror : "It's a little bit of that [managing him]. He came off the other day [at Everton ] with a little bit of cramp.

"We didn't want to take any risks really. We tried to manage him so we will see how he is after this one."

With Shaw unavailable, Carrick reorganized his lineup, handing Patrick Dorgu the nod at left-back. The Danish fullback delivered an impressive performance, setting up Matheus Cunha for the Red Devils' opening goal while also contributing to the side's first clean sheet of the season.

Dorgu was additionally awarded Player of the Match honors. Reflecting on United's dominant victory, he said: "It was good. Really thank you to god for giving me the opportunity to play in the Champions League.

"I'm really happy with my performance and really happy that the team got the three points and are up and running in the Champions League."

He added: "The last couple of games, we conceded a lot of goals so it was good to get the confidence going into the derby at the weekend."

articles.title: Detenidos cuatro jóvenes por los altercados previos al Valencia-Barcelona de la pasada temporada
articles.standfirst: Se produjo una "grave alteración del orden público" con lanzamiento de sillas, papeleras y botellas contra la Policía a las afueras de Mestalla
articles.summary: Se produjo una "grave alteración del orden público" con lanzamiento de sillas, papeleras y botellas contra la Policía a las afueras de Mestalla
articles.body: La Policía Nacional detuvo en Valencia a cuatro hombres, de entre 18 y 21 años, como presuntos autores de delitos de desórdenes públicos y atentado contra agentes de la autoridad por su supuesta participación en los incidentes registrados antes del partido entre el Valencia y el Barcelona disputado en Mestalla el pasado 23 de mayo. Los arrestados estarían implicados en los altercados ocurridos en las inmediaciones del estadio y, presuntamente, "alentado a la masa a acometer contra los policías, ocasionando una grave alteración del orden público", según un comunicado policial. La Policía precisa que los hechos se produjeron después de una manifestación de aficionados valencianistas que transcurrió sin incidentes y concluyó en el estadio a las 19.00 horas. Los disturbios comenzaron alrededor de las 19.30 horas, tras el paso del autobús del equipo local, cuando fueron encendidas varias bengalas. En ese momento, añaden las fuentes policiales, agentes de la Unidad de Intervención Policial (UIP) desplegados en el dispositivo de seguridad comenzaron a sufrir agresiones por parte de "un grupo numeroso de jóvenes, aficionados al Valencia", mediante el lanzamiento de objetos como "botellas de cristal y latas de cerveza". La situación se agravó posteriormente cuando algunos participantes supuestamente arrojaron "mobiliario urbano, como sillas y papeleras que se encontraban en las terrazas de los bares", lo que obligó a los agentes a reforzar el cordón de seguridad y adoptar medidas de contención y dispersión para recuperar el control de la zona. Según la Policía, los incidentes comprometieron no solo la seguridad de los agentes desplegados, sino también la de los aficionados presentes. Un policía resultó herido en un brazo por el impacto de una botella de cristal y se produjo una "grave alteración del orden público" que derivó en carreras, empujones y caídas entre los asistentes, como muestran las imágenes. La investigación ha sido desarrollada por la Brigada Provincial de Información. Como resultado de las pesquisas, los agentes ya detuvieron el pasado 4 de junio a un hombre de 36 años por estos mismos hechos. A esa actuación se sumaron este jueves las detenciones de otros cuatro sospechosos. Los cinco investigados quedaron posteriormente en libertad, aunque fueron informados de su obligación de comparecer ante la autoridad judicial cuando sean requeridos. La Policía Nacional señala que la investigación continúa abierta y que, por el momento, no se descartan nuevas detenciones relacionadas con estos altercados.

articles.title: Manolo González: “Lo único que nos vale es ganar los tres partidos”
articles.standfirst: El técnico perico explicaba que el equipo llega con la moral alta y con buenas sensaciones al duelo ante Osasuna
articles.summary: El técnico perico explicaba que el equipo llega con la moral alta y con buenas sensaciones al duelo ante Osasuna
articles.body: El Espanyol se entrena mañana a Osasuna a domicilio. Un duelo curioso en los banquillos, ya que precisamente, Manolo González fue el sustituto de Ramis en el banquillo blanquiazul. Tras empatar en casa ante el Sevilla, el Espanyol quiere sumar los tres puntos y la que sería la segunda victoria de la temporada. El técnico perico comparecía hoy ante los medios y comentaba que en una semana en la que tocará afrontar varios partidos de manera consecutiva, el equipo quiere sumar los 9 puntos. También ha sido autocrítico y ha hablado sobre los aspectos que debe mejorar el equipo. A por los 9 puntos de esta semana: “Pues los nueve. No miramos otra cosa. Miramos los tres de mañana, que son los primeros. Sabemos que tenemos dos partidos complicados, pero nosotros siempre queremos ganar y la única cosa que nos vale es ganar los tres partidos. Así que saldremos con esta mentalidad de combatir al máximo nivel y después, entre el acierto que tengamos y tenga el rival, dictará la sentencia. Pero nosotros saldremos con la mentalidad de ganar los nueve puntos que tenemos”. Bryan Zaragoza, mejor: “Siempre una semana más te da tiempo para ponerte mejor. Poco a poco él irá tomando ritmo, irá mejorando poco a poco. Está muy bien desde el primer día que vino con muchas ganas de estar en el Espanyol. Él ya hizo un esfuerzo para venir aquí y mañana, cuando tenga que salir, si es de inicio o si es la segunda parte, saldrá a tope seguro”. Partido distinto al del curso pasado: “Hace poco tiempo pero han cambiado de entrenador, el estilo no se parece demasiado y es un partido diferente porque nosotros hemos cambiado jugadores, ellos también”. Trabajo de la semana para mejorar: “Nos faltó ritmo de balón, ya no por el campo, sino por situaciones nuestras, que es lo que dije. Hemos tocado cosas que hemos detectado en las primeras jornadas que no hacíamos tan bien como hacíamos antes. Entonces hemos vuelto un poco a no perder lo que hemos hecho bien, pero sí también a potenciar lo otro”. Confianza en Riedel: “En la misma que estaba cuando empezó. Como un central de la plantilla que puede jugar cualquier partido y que nosotros estamos muy contentos con él. Confiamos mucho en Clemens desde que llegó aquí, lo hemos demostrado, pese a su juventud es un jugador que para nosotros es importante”. Hartman sigue adaptándose: “Tiene un proceso de adaptación al juego, al ritmo, que está llevando bien y que esperamos que nos dé rendimiento de aquí en adelante. Lo bueno que tiene, que por eso explicamos el cambio de otro día, es que era un cambio ofensivo porque nos da mucho pie, nos da muy buen centro y entiende el juego muy bien. Plan de partido: “Nosotros intentaremos con nuestras armas competir al máximo nivel y si podemos llevar todo el peso del partido, mejor. Sabemos que en Primera hay muy pocos equipos de la liga que tengan la capacidad de llevar el peso durante 90 minutos de un partido a favor suyo siempre”. El 11, una incógnita: “Intentamos que los jugadores estén preparados para jugar, que todos sepan el rol que tienen, porque si un jugador ve el martes que no va a jugar lógicamente se deja ir y esto nosotros no lo queremos. Si no se lo he dicho a ellos, no lo voy a decir aquí y mañana tendréis que verlo antes del partido”. Buenas sensaciones del equipo: “Con buenas sensaciones. El equipo está bien, repito. Tenemos partidos mejores, peores, como todos los equipos de la Liga. Estamos en la jornada 4 que ningún equipo está rodado al 100%. Entonces es momento de intentar que el equipo mejore”. Gorosabel necesita tiempo: “Andoni viene de un periodo de entreno con su equipo en el cual no estaba adaptado de todo con el grupo. Lo que estamos haciendo con Bryan Zaragoza, a otro nivel, es intentar que con Andoni Gorosabel sea lo mismo, que se adapte rápido a las cargas y demás”. Nivel defensivo del Espanyol: “Yo el día que me voy más descontento a nivel defensivo, porque el día del Sevilla para mí es más un problema de balón que defensivo, es el día de Anoeta, que los dos goles llegan en dos transiciones y eso sí que me molesta bastante”. Preparados para competir en cualquier campo: “El rival entre que juega en su estadio y que tiene jugadores de nivel es un partido exigente. Pero repito, nos vemos capacitados para afrontar un partido contra cualquier rival en cualquier campo ahora mismo”.

articles.title: Minnesota inks first helmet bumper ad sponsorship deal with Verizon’s Visible
articles.summary: Minnesota football is entering a new era of sponsorships. Gopher Athletics and Learfield’s Gopher Sports Properties announced Friday that Minnesota has reach...
articles.body:
Minnesota football is entering a new era of sponsorships. Gopher Athletics and Learfield's Gopher Sports Properties announced Friday that Minnesota has reached a partnership with Visible , the digital-first wireless carrier powered by Verizon's network.

As part of the agreement , Visible will become the first-ever helmet bumper partner for Minnesota football. Beginning Sept. 12, the Visible logo will appear on the back of every Golden Gophers football helmet.

The move makes Minnesota one of the first college football programs to feature a corporate brand on its helmet and the first Learfield partner to do so. The new helmet bumper will debut when Minnesota hosts Mississippi State at Huntington Bank Stadium. That matchup will air nationally on CBS at 2:30 p.m. CT and will also serve as Minnesota's "Gold Out."

"As college athletics continues to evolve, it's important that we identify innovative opportunities that strengthen our programs and department and continue to help provide a world-class experience for our student-athletes," Minnesota athletic director Mark Coyle said in a release.

The agreement comes after the NCAA recently approved commercial logos on college athletic uniforms, opening another potential revenue stream for athletic departments. Minnesota is among the first schools to take advantage.

"We are excited to welcome Visible and proud to be among the first programs in the country to introduce helmet bumper branding," Coyle said. "This partnership reflects the continued momentum of our department and our commitment to building relationships with organizations that invest in the future of Gopher Athletics."

Moreover, Visible will receive a prominent placement on Minnesota's helmets throughout the season, putting the company directly into the Gophers' game-day presentation and national television appearances.

David Kim, president at Verizon Value, called the partnership a unique opportunity for Visible as it continues growing its presence in the Twin Cities: "Appearing on every Minnesota football helmet gives Visible a bold presence on one of college football's biggest stages," Kim said. "We're proud to partner with Gopher Athletics on this first-of-its-kind opportunity."

Continuing, the sponsorship represents another example of the changing commercial landscape across college athletics. Revenue generation has become increasingly important as athletic departments navigate revenue sharing and other financial changes throughout the sport. Uniform and helmet branding now provides schools with another asset to sell to corporate partners.

"Helmet branding represents a new opportunity in college sports, and Minnesota is one of the first programs to bring this to life with a national brand," Learfield president of Sports Properties Kim Damron said.

All told, the Visible branding will make its first appearance against Mississippi State, which will mark the first-ever meeting between the Gophers and Bulldogs. For Minnesota, it will also mark the beginning of a new kind of partnership, one that will be visible on every snap.

articles.title: An 'upset' Christian Pulisic to make season debut Saturday, says AC Milan manager
articles.summary: Pulisic has been an unused sub in the club's first three games after returning from an injury suffered during the World Cup.
articles.body:
Christian Pulisic is part of Rubin Amorim 's plans for Saturday's match against Lazio , the AC Milan manager said.

"I think you guys are going to see Pulisic," Amorim told reporters on Friday . "I don't know if he's going to start, if he's going to get on the pitch. I think he's going to play at least some minutes now."

Pulisic suffered a bone bruise and microfracture in his right leg during the United States' Round of 16 defeat to Belgium during the 2026 World Cup . Upon his return to training with AC Milan, he picked up a knock, according to Amorim. Now healthy, the 27-year-old has been an unused substitute in the Serie A side's opening three games of the season.

The lack of playing time has left Pulisic "upset," Amorim said, but with AC Milan off to a 2-0-1 start, the manager is sticking to his ways and not changing a lineup that's been successful early on.

"He's upset, in the moment, because he has zero minutes and I love that," Amorim said. "I love that in my players, but he's ready to play."

Amorim talked about squad rotation and how everyone will need to be ready. AC Milan has three matches in an eight-day span, including a midweek UEFA Europa League fixture against Benfica on Wednesday, before the upcoming international break.

Pulisic is entering his fourth season in Italy and is coming off a campaign that saw him score 10 goals and record 14 goal contributions in 34 matches in all competitions.

articles.title: Florida soccer falls to South Carolina to begin conference play
articles.summary: Florida soccer remains in the IWSOC Coaches Poll for the third straight week following its loss to Wake Forest.
articles.body:
Florida soccer has been on a skid as of late, losing two straight games as conference play begins. The Gators have played two back-to-back nationally ranked teams and have fallen to both of them.

The program will have eight days in between before their next match to clean up around the edges and return to the winning column.

UF has a grueling conference schedule, playing three ranked teams as the season goes on. With a week of preparation ahead of their match against Mississippi State, hopefully they flip the switch on the road before returning home.

Here's a look at the latest Florida soccer weekly update, including how the Gators fared in their previous matches, where they stand in the most recent national rankings, and what's ahead for the program.

Florida suffers loss to No. 5 Wake Forest

Florida had many opportunities against the top-five opponent but failed to execute. The Gators had the game tied 1-1 following a goal from sophomore Tatum Borman in the 58th minute; however, the Demon Deacons answered in the 80th minute with a penalty kick that allowed them to skate by in a 2-1 victory. To this point, the Orange and Blue were the only team to score a goal on Wake Forest.

"Super proud of the group. We created a lot of really good chances. That team's No. 5 in the country. They went to the College Cup two years ago and they returned basically every single starter. I thought we were very, very good. We gave them everything they could handle and dominated long stretches of the game. Sometimes football is cruel that way, but I'm incredibly proud of the group, the chances we created and the fight to come back, tie it and continue going all the way to the end." Florida head Coach Nick Zimmerman said.

"We added Wake when I got here, and it was for this exact reason. We want to play teams that challenge us and we can learn a lot from it. We want to be in these games because that's who we are. That's the type of program we want. We scheduled this. This was our decision, and I'm glad we did because this was a great game and a great experience for us," he concluded.

Gators extend losing streak against No. 19 Gamecocks

What was expected to be a strong opening statement for Florida soccer in conference play instead ended in a minimal defeat. No. 23 Florida opened SEC play with a 1-0 loss to No. 19 South Carolina on Thursday night on the road.

South Carolina's Reese Slater scored the match's lone goal in the 40th minute.

Florida, which entered the match 19-9-4 all-time in SEC openers, nearly tied it before the break; however, Zoe Main's shot attempt clipped the crossbar.

The Gators continued to apply pressure and stay on the attack, recording four shots in the final 20 seconds. South Carolina goalkeeper Christina Tsaousis was a stout defender and came up with saves in the closing seconds of the half.

Florida attempted to close the gap, but nothing went their way in the second, thus falling to the conference foe.

"Always a very tough place to play. South Carolina doesn't concede many goals and this was a great environment for our young group to experience. Lot of credit to South Carolina. We will recover and we will go again as we prepare for another very good opponent next week." Zimmerman said.

Florida will now look to regroup as its SEC schedule continues.

After the Gators suffered their loss to the Demon Deacons, their ranking in the IWSOC Coaches Poll slipped two spots after previously being ranked No. 21. The tough loss to South Carolina may knock the UF out of the top 25 when the next poll rankings are released, given the fact that there are no other three-loss teams within the top 25 or even right outside of it.

articles.title: Canal + y LaLiga firman un acuerdo histórico para combatir la piratería de contenidos deportivos
articles.standfirst: Abarca cerca de 50 países de Europa, África Subsahariana y Haití
articles.summary: Abarca cerca de 50 países de Europa, África Subsahariana y Haití
articles.body: Canal+ y LALIGA han anunciado hoy la firma de un innovador acuerdo estratégico contra la piratería que abarca cerca de 50 países de Europa, África Subsahariana y Haití El acuerdo representa una de las colaboraciones más ambiciosas jamás establecidas entre un operador audiovisual global y una gran organización deportiva para hacer frente a una de las mayores amenazas a las que se enfrenta hoy la industria del deporte Combinarán su experiencia, tecnología y sus capacidades de actuación en la lucha contra la piratería. Ya situados entre los actores más comprometidos y proactivos en este ámbito, ambos socios llevan ahora sus esfuerzos a un nuevo nivel para proteger el ecosistema deportivo y su modelo de financiación, al tiempo que continúan ofreciendo experiencias de fútbol excepcionales a los aficionados. Esta colaboración permitirá a ambas organizaciones compartir inteligencia, coordinar estrategias de actuación y acelerar las acciones contra las redes de distribución ilegal que operan en múltiples territorios. Tal y como detalla Javier Tebas, presidente de LALIGA "la piratería es uno de los mayores desafíos para el futuro del deporte profesional. Ninguna organización puede afrontar este problema por sí sola, y por eso alianzas como esta son tan importantes. Al unir fuerzas con CANAL+, combinamos tecnología, inteligencia y capacidades operativas" Según detalló Maxime Saada, CEO de Canal+ añade que "nuestro Grupo comparte una convicción común con LaLiga, una de las ligas deportivas más comprometidas con la lucha contra la piratería: la piratería socava todo el ecosistema deportivo. Al aunar nuestra experiencia en la lucha contra la piratería, estamos reforzando significativamente nuestra capacidad de actuación". La piratería ya no es únicamente un problema de derechos de autor; se ha convertido en una de las mayores amenazas para la sostenibilidad del deporte, al poner en riesgo la inversión, la innovación y el valor a largo plazo de los derechos audiovisuales. Para CANAL+ y LALIGA, proteger los contenidos deportivos también significa proteger a los aficionados y consumidores. Los servicios ilegales exponen a los usuarios a riesgos muy reales, como el robo de datos personales, el malware, el fraude o el acceso a contenidos no regulados. Al reforzar conjuntamente sus esfuerzos contra la piratería, ambas organizaciones buscan ofrecer a los aficionados un acceso seguro, fiable y de máxima calidad a una de las competiciones de fútbol más seguidas del mundo.
